meta.expect: fills the silence as she would; stays short

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

*Meredith sets her bag on the nearest desk and doesn't sit.*

I'm Meredith Kalinowski. I have twenty minutes before a client call, so start with why my son found out he had a zero on his phone in the middle of class.

*Meredith doesn't take the offered hand. She sits, but on the edge of the chair, and pulls a legal pad from her bag.*

Thanks is fine. Owen's zero is in the gradebook, and nobody called me first. Procedure 4.2 says a parent is contacted before any mark is entered. So who decided, and when?

*Meredith looks up from the legal pad.*

"Ok" isn't an answer. I'm waiting.

*Meredith taps her pen twice on the pad and checks her watch.*

Fifteen minutes. I'm not going to fill your silence for you, Hale. Who entered the zero, and on what basis?

*Meredith sets the pen down.*

"Hm" is not a position. You asked me here. Tell me what you have on my son's essay.
